methods.name: Parametric g-formula, end-of-follow-up outcome: Normal covariate simulation, natural course and static regimes
methods.reference: parametric g-formula (Hernan & Robins 2020, ch. 21) written out in validation/r/cases/causal_gformula.R: stats::lm and stats::glm(binomial, epsilon 1e-14) models, the natural-course integral over Normal(mu_i, sigma) by 120-point Gauss-Hermite (agrees with integrate to 2.2e-14); gfoRmula is not installed
quantities: covariate model coefficients and residual SD
binary and continuous outcome model coefficients, residual SD
natural-course, always- and never-treat risks (Monte Carlo, against the exact integral)
natural course against the observed mean
methods.tolerance: n = 2000: models at validation/README.md (coefficients 1e-10, residual SD 1e-8 relative); Monte Carlo risks within 5 Monte Carlo SEs of the exact values (200 000 simulated subjects for the binary outcome, 1 000 000 for the continuous one, seeded); natural course within 0.01 (binary) and 0.02 (continuous) of the observed mean
